[[File:A-9 NEGVV.png|250px|thumb|The A-9 ''Vigilance'' interceptor]]
The '''A-series interceptors''' was a series of short-range [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Kuat Defense Force]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The craft included the [[A-6 Interceptor]], [[A-7 Hunter Interceptor|A-7 ''Hunter'' Interceptor]], [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor|A-9 ''Vigilance'' interceptor]], and [[A-10 interceptor]].
